note: Upstairs shapes-and-sizes studio (first floor, rarer words). Feminine nouns on the left (la grandeur, la tonne, l'épaisseur, la résolution); masculine nouns on the right (le centimètre, le géant, le foudre, le carreau, le diamètre, le pourtour, l'hexagone); adjectives régulier and carré in the centre. Stairs DOWN at the far left lead back to the colour studio; the blue door on the back wall leads to the second shapes room.
